name: bmad-portal-vscode
description: VS Code extension for BMad Portal Hub - IDE Integration & Dashboard Display

bmadPortal.backendHubUrl.description: Base URL of the BMad Portal Backend Hub this extension connects to (WebSocket/REST).

bmadPortal.repoPollingIntervalSec.description: Interval, in seconds, at which the extension polls local repo state and reports it to the Backend Hub. Real polling engine ships in Story 7.2.

bmadPortal.authMethod.description: Authentication method used to obtain the session token stored in VS Code Secret Storage. Real Secret Storage flow ships in Story 7.4.

bmadPortal.dashboardDisplayMode.description: How the BMad Portal dashboard is displayed.

bmadPortal.enableEventDrivenPolling.description: When true, a detected local Git event triggers an immediate state upload without disrupting the next scheduled poll. Real override ships in Story 7.3.

bmadPortal.dashboardRefreshIntervalSec.description: Interval, in seconds, at which dashboard Web View widgets refresh their data from the Backend Hub. Real widgets ship in Story 7.6.

bmadPortal.claimsSuggestionsEnabled.description: When true, claims suggestions are enabled in the Command Palette. Real suggestions ship in Story 7.7.

bmadPortal.jwtToken.description: JWT token for direct authentication with the Backend Hub. When provided, the extension uses this token directly instead of going through the authentication flow. Token should have long expiration (e.g., 10 years) for workspace sessions.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
